Cycles de ORO Saturday Social Ride

Greensboro, NC · Road

Cycles de ORO Saturday Social Ride is a road group ride in Greensboro, NC. It rolls every Saturday at 10:00 am from Cycles de ORO. Pace: conversational, short distances, group stays together. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: conversational, short distances, group stays together. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Cycles de ORO Saturday Social Ride group ride

Saturday morning social ride from the shop at a conversational pace. Start time is on the shop's site and changes with the season.
